hints.content: A prime number has exactly two factors: $1$ and itself.

The factors of $25$ are $1, 5,$ and $25.$

$25$ has $3$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $33$ are $1, 3, 11,$ and $33.$

$33$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $63$ are $1, 3, 7, 9, 21,$ and $63.$

$63$ has $6$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $64$ are $1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32,$ and $64.$

$64$ has $7$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $71$ are $1$ and $71.$

$71$ has **exactly** two factors so it is a prime number.
